sno.review:
Tahsin Hridita Sno is very easygoing. Just be attentive in his class. He sometimes gives tricky questions, but they’re doable. There’s one group report writing assignment. He gives math in quizzes, mids, and finals and the final includes both MCQs and math. Lastly, he also gives bonus marks.
Sys is great for learning. Be attentive and take notes during class because he often gives hints about what might come in the exam. Quizzes are MCQ based, while the mid and final include math and short questions. The slides are enough if you pay attention in class and also gives practice problem before mid and final.

Jannatul Ferdous Sir is very easygoing, and the plus point is that all the quizzes, midterm, and final are math based. There is one viva which is the theoretical part and in the viva he likes answers with examples. If you score well in the midterm, final, and quizzes, you can easily get an A in this course. Also he checks papers in an easy way.The best 2 quizzes out of 3 will be counted.

Sno sir is a math lover sir. Sir er kachhe I did course in MBA level. Sei experience share korlam.
BUS635 — Sno
Obtained Grade : A-
If you are a math lover, then Sno sir can be the best choice for you. Sir himself loves math and delivers very engaging lectures. If you take his class, you will actually enjoy the class and subject. He teaches very well. In class, he mainly focuses on mathematical problems.
There are 2 quizzes (best 1 is counted), a midterm, and a final, all of which are math-based. Sir practices a lot of math problems in class, and the exam questions come from those same problems. But, Sir makes the questions a bit tricky, and to understand those tricks, you must practice a lot.
There will be one individual or group assignment—make sure to do it well. Sir gives partial marks. For example, if most parts are correct, you can get 8 or 8.5 out of 10. Even if the approach is not fully correct, he still gives around 6 out of 10. If the overall class performance is poor, he provides a bonus assignment and curves the grades that way.
Grading is fair. In our class, there were 10 students who received A or A-.
He’s being so nice throughout sem. Just j maths gulo imp Oigulo e uni class e korabe and uni maths er interpretation Onek pochondo korey and just not the vague answer.
Mgt314 Sno. Teaches really well plus curves a grade if required.

mdrh.review: Tasmim Tarannum MdRH is the most humble faculty I've met in NSU till now. I did bus173. He is really easygoing and explains every topic thoroughly. He also gives practice math from the textbook, and only those will be included in the exams. His grading is also fair and maths bhul korle partial marking kore. Cons are he is really strict in exams. Even the slightest intention of cheating will result in the cancellation of the exam. Apart from that, sir really is a gem.

One of the most humble faculties I've come across to date. Sir teaches well and in a very detailed manner. However, I found his lectures to be a bit slow. He took three quizzes and counted the best two. The first quiz had definitions and T/F questions. The rest of the quizzes were based on maths only. There were two mids. In the first mid, he gave two theoretical and two mathematical questions. In the second mid, there was one theoretical question and three maths. The final had four mathematical questions. In all of these exams, we had to answer three questions. His theoretical questions were not the easiest, as he made them in such a way that connected theories with real-world applications. So, only memorizing the theories from the book won't guarantee good marks. The maths, on the other hand, were very straightforward. He will highlight maths from the book, and you will face exactly the same or similar maths in the exams. He took one group assignment and gave plenty of time to submit. Finally, he curved based on the section's overall performance.
